_comment: Ordered tile-rect -> encounter zone table for the 128x96 overworld (geography.md Region Boundaries / Key Landmark Positions / Encounter Zones). First match wins: sacred/urban zero-zones, then act-gated Pallor approach, then roads, then Thornmere zones (priority over Valdris/Compact in overlap bands per geography.md), then regional fills. Rects are inclusive [x1, y1, x2, y2] tile coords. Road strips and sub-zone splits are placeholder geometry pending the real overworld tileset; ocean tiles are impassable and intentionally unmapped (resolve to no zone).

zone_rects._comment: Sacred sites - no encounters (geography.md: Ashgrove 48,48; Stillwater Hollow 42,44)
Urban approaches - no encounters (3x3 around each settlement landmark, geography.md Key Landmark Positions)
Act III Pallor epicenter, 10-mile (4-tile) radius around the Convergence 52,52 (geography.md Encounter Zones: Pallor Wastes Act III)
Valdris Highroad (Aelhart -> Valdris Crown -> Thornwatch) and Compact roads (Ironmouth -> Gael's Span -> Corrund -> Ashmark); placeholder strips
Duskfen marsh system (geography.md: Marshland, Duskfen system)
Deep Thornmere core (Roothollow / Maren's Refuge / Greywood Camp)
Eastern Thornmere fringe (Canopy Reach / Sunstone Ridge side)
Outer Thornmere band; listed before Valdris/Compact fills so the Thornmere region takes overlap priority (geography.md Region Boundaries)
Frostcap Peaks northern edge of Valdris territory (geography.md: Mountains)
Ley-scarred eastern Valdris border around Greyvale; zone has no sanctioned design-table row - see follow-up issue
